tldr: 台股三個交易日重挫 1,576 點、外資狂賣 632 億元，金管會出面喊話強調基本面仍穩健。
輝達主導全球盤面——Vera CPU 首批出貨 Anthropic、OpenAI，鴻海、廣達接伺服器大單，華爾街為財報後 3,550 億美元市值波動預作準備。
30 年期美債殖利率飆上 19 年新高、債市再掀拋售，壓抑股市並推升美元，新台幣同步貶至 31.65 元。
財政部鬆口評估金融「公民併」，市場解讀國票金（國產票券金控）可能是整併對象之一。
克里夫蘭聯準銀行模型預估美國 5 月通膨恐破 4%，降息希望幾近破滅，正值華許（Kevin Warsh）即將宣誓接任 Fed 主席。

items.title_zh: 台股三天狂瀉 1,576 點 金管會喊話：基本面沒變
items.title_en: Taiwan stocks tumble 1,576 points in three days as FSC says fundamentals hold
items.summary_zh: 台股連三個交易日重挫、累計下跌 1,576 點，光是 5 月 19 日外資就賣超擴大至 632 億元。證期局副局長黃仲豪表示，從本益比、殖利率與上市櫃營收來看，「台股基本面仍穩健」，信用交易擔保維持率維持相對穩定水準，市場尚未出現失序情況。在全球殖利率走升下，外資資金明顯轉向防禦型族群避險，後市觀望氣氛濃厚。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index has fallen 1,576 points over three trading sessions, with foreign investors expanding net selling to NT$63.2bn on May 19 alone. Securities and Futures Bureau deputy director-general Huang Chung-hao said price-to-earnings ratios, dividend yields and listed-company revenues all show "Taiwan equities' fundamentals remain solid," and that margin-maintenance ratios are stable with no signs of disorderly trading. Foreign money has rotated toward defensive sectors as global yields rise.

items.title_zh: 聯發科遭處置後 金管會啟動檢討 大型權值股鬆綁有望？
items.title_en: FSC reviews curbs on large-cap stocks after MediaTek disposal measure
items.summary_zh: 大型權值股聯發科遭列入處置股後，金管會啟動制度檢討，評估現行處置規範是否對大型、高權重個股造成不合理影響。主管機關正衡量是否放寬大型指數成分股的處置門檻，因為對巨型權值股設限，反而可能放大整體指數波動、未必能抑制投機，後續鬆綁方向受市場關注。
items.summary_en: Following the imposition of disposal (trading-restriction) measures on heavyweight MediaTek, the FSC has launched a review of whether the rules unduly penalise large-cap, high-weighting stocks. Regulators are weighing whether to relax disposal thresholds for major index constituents, since restrictions on giant stocks can amplify volatility across the whole index rather than curb speculation.

items.title_zh: 元大 00940 ETF 換血！台新新光、凱基金等 10 檔入列 剔除第一大持股長榮
items.title_en: Yuanta 00940 ETF reshuffles: KGI Financial and Taishin financials in, Evergreen Marine out
items.summary_zh: 臺灣指數公司公布元大台灣價值高息 ETF（00940）追蹤指數定期審核結果，本次換股「10 進 10 出」，相關成分股變動自 5 月 20 日起生效。其中凱基金與台新新光金兩大金控被納入，原第一大持股長榮海運則遭剔除。由於 00940 是台灣散戶持有規模最大的高股息 ETF 之一，此次成分股大幅輪動牽動龐大被動資金流向。
items.summary_en: The Taiwan Index Plus Corp announced the semi-annual review results for the index tracked by the Yuanta Taiwan Value High Dividend ETF (00940), with 10 stocks added and 10 removed effective May 20. KGI Financial and Taishin Shin Kong Financial are both newly included, while top holding Evergreen Marine is dropped — a notable rotation given 00940 is one of Taiwan's largest retail-held dividend ETFs.

items.title_zh: 輝達 Vera CPU 出貨 首批賣給 Anthropic、OpenAI 鴻海、廣達迎伺服器大單
items.title_en: Nvidia ships first Vera CPUs to Anthropic and OpenAI; Hon Hai, Quanta win server orders
items.summary_zh: 輝達宣布最新 AI 平台 Vera Rubin 的首批 Vera CPU，已於 5 月 15 日及 18 日陸續出貨給 Anthropic、OpenAI、SpaceX AI 及甲骨文等北美雲端大廠。出貨效應沿供應鏈擴散，台廠伺服器代工龍頭鴻海、廣達同步接獲大單，為 AI 硬體供應鏈注入強心針，即使近期半導體股回檔，相關拉貨動能仍受看好。
items.summary_en: Nvidia announced that the first batch of Vera CPUs from its new Vera Rubin AI platform shipped on May 15 and 18 to North American cloud giants including Anthropic, OpenAI, SpaceX's AI unit and Oracle. The rollout cascades down the supply chain, with Taiwan server assemblers Hon Hai and Quanta securing large orders — a positive signal for the AI hardware chain even as semiconductor stocks correct.

items.title_zh: 黃仁勳看好 AI 黃金十年 直言建置仍在最初期
items.title_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang touts an AI "golden decade," expects China market to reopen
items.summary_zh: 在輝達公布季度財報前夕，執行長黃仁勳釋出正向訊息，強調 AI 基礎設施建置仍在「最初期」，相關需求可望延續至未來十年。他並表示，預期中國大陸市場終會開放，同時重申台灣仍將是半導體製造的核心。法人認為，黃仁勳唱旺 AI 長線前景，有助穩定近期回檔的 AI 供應鏈投資信心。
items.summary_en: Ahead of Nvidia's quarterly results, CEO Jensen Huang said AI infrastructure build-out is "still in the very early stages" and demand should run for the next ten years. He also said he expects China's market to eventually open up, and reaffirmed Taiwan will remain the core of semiconductor manufacturing — comments analysts view as supportive for AI-chain sentiment.

items.title_zh: 蘋果 WWDC 6 月 9 日登場 庫克最後一場秀 台積、大立光可望受惠
items.title_en: Apple's WWDC opens June 9 — Tim Cook's last keynote, with TSMC and Largan set to benefit
items.summary_zh: 蘋果宣布 2026 年全球開發者大會（WWDC）將於台灣時間 6 月 9 日凌晨登場，外界預期將發表全新 iOS 27、搭載 AI 的 Siri，以及介面大改版的相機 App。市場普遍解讀，這將是執行長庫克交棒前的最後一場主題演講；台積電、大立光等台廠供應鏈，可望受惠後續新品周期與備貨動能。
items.summary_en: Apple announced its 2026 Worldwide Developers Conference begins June 9 (Taiwan time). Markets expect a new iOS 27, an AI-powered Siri and a redesigned Camera app. It is widely seen as CEO Tim Cook's final keynote before a leadership handover; Taiwan suppliers including TSMC and Largan Precision are positioned to benefit from the new product cycle.

items.title_zh: 記憶體雙雄海外募資千億擴產 三星前總裁示警超級循環近尾聲
items.title_en: Memory duo raises hundreds of billions overseas to expand, even as ex-Samsung exec warns the cycle is peaking
items.summary_zh: 台灣記憶體雙雄合計規劃在海外募資約千億元新台幣，用於購料與擴產，法人看好有助搶攻 HBM 與高規 DDR5 商機。不過三星一名高級顧問示警，記憶體「超級循環」恐近尾聲，推估明年下半年價格將實質下跌、後年市場萎縮。產業因此呈現「短多長空」拉鋸：眼前需求火熱、擴產積極，但對 2027 年後的價格反轉須提高警覺。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's two big memory makers are raising about NT$100bn offshore to fund material purchases and capacity expansion, with analysts saying it helps them seize HBM and DDR5 demand. But a senior Samsung adviser warned the memory "super-cycle" is nearing its end, predicting prices begin a real decline in 2H 2027 and the market shrinks the following year — leaving the sector split between near-term boom and longer-term caution.

items.title_zh: 遠傳低軌衛星跨步 與亞馬遜 Amazon Leo 簽署合作協議
items.title_en: FET signs on as Taiwan distributor for Amazon's Leo low-orbit satellite service
items.summary_zh: 遠傳電信宣布與亞馬遜旗下低軌衛星網路服務「Amazon Leo」簽署合作協議，成為台灣授權經銷商，是繼中華電信引進低軌衛星營運後，國內電信業者在衛星通訊市場的再一次布局。此舉顯示台灣低軌衛星市場競爭升溫，也為電信業者開闢新的成長動能與企業／偏鄉連網商機。
items.summary_en: Far EasTone Telecommunications announced a partnership with Amazon's "Amazon Leo" low-earth-orbit satellite network, becoming an authorised Taiwan distributor. It follows Chunghwa Telecom's earlier move into LEO services, signalling intensifying competition in Taiwan's satellite-connectivity market and a fresh growth avenue for telecom operators.

items.title_zh: ASML：High-NA EUV 製晶片數月內亮相 點名台積、三星 AI 瓶頸
items.title_en: ASML says first High-NA EUV-made chips arrive within months, flagging TSMC and Samsung bottlenecks
items.summary_zh: ASML 執行長福克（Christophe Fouquet）表示，市場可望在數月內看到首批以新一代 High-NA EUV 設備製造的晶片產品問世，代表先進製程正式邁向下一階段。他並點名台積電、三星等客戶在 AI 需求帶動下面臨產能瓶頸。此進展攸關先進製程競賽節奏，也牽動半導體設備與晶圓代工後續資本支出布局。
items.summary_en: ASML CEO Christophe Fouquet said the market should see the first chip products manufactured with next-generation High-NA EUV lithography within months, marking advanced process technology entering its next phase. He pointed to AI-driven capacity bottlenecks at customers including TSMC and Samsung as the industry pushes toward ever-finer nodes.

items.title_zh: 財部鬆口評估金融「公民併」 市場解讀國票金是可能對象
items.title_en: Ministry of Finance signals study of public-private bank mergers; market eyes Waterland Financial
items.summary_zh: 財政部長莊翠雲赴立法院財委會專題報告，書面報告指出，除目前推動的公股投信「四合一」整併外，也督請各公股金融機構在確保公股經營主導權前提下，依業務發展方向評估推動「公民併」（公股與民營整併）。市場解讀此鬆口訊號，國票金（國產票券金控）被點名為可能的整併對象之一，後續公股整併路徑與主導權安排成觀察重點。
items.summary_en: Finance Minister Chuang Tsui-yun's written report to the Legislative Yuan's Finance Committee says that, beyond the ongoing four-way merger of state-owned investment-trust firms, the ministry has asked state-controlled financials to evaluate "public-private mergers" — provided the state retains management control. Markets read the signal as opening the door to a deal involving Waterland Financial Holdings.

items.title_zh: 中信金法說：2026 年估升息 1 碼 銀行淨利息收入可增 11 億元
items.title_en: CTBC Financial forecasts a quarter-point rate hike by Taiwan's central bank in 2026
items.summary_zh: 中信金控舉行法說會，總經理暨發言人高麗雪估計台灣將「雙率雙升」，今年經濟成長率可望超過 8%，並預期央行 6 月啟動升息，全年升息 1 碼；新台幣匯價年底向 30 至 30.5 元靠攏。她推算若升息 1 碼，中信銀行淨利息收入可增加約 11 億元。此一升息預期，對銀行利差與金控獲利結構具指標意義。
items.summary_en: At its earnings call, CTBC Financial president and spokesperson Kao Li-hsueh estimated Taiwan will see "twin rises" in interest and exchange rates, with 2026 GDP growth potentially topping 8%. She expects the central bank to begin hiking in June, for a full-year increase of one quarter-point (one "notch"), which she calculates would lift the banking unit's net interest income by about NT$1.1bn.

items.title_zh: 期貨商資本拉警報 14 家中 10 家規劃增資或發債
items.title_en: Futures brokers' capital ratios under strain — 10 of 14 plan to raise capital or issue bonds
items.summary_zh: 台股交投熱絡推升期貨交易量，未沖銷部位保證金總額急遽擴大，導致期貨商「風險調整後淨資本額比率（ANC 比率）」普遍下滑。據金管會統計，14 家專營期貨商已有 10 家規劃增資或發債補強資本；金管會強調 14 家目前全數合規，期交所也已啟動制度檢討。此事凸顯交易爆量下，期貨業資本適足與風險控管同步承壓。
items.summary_en: With Taiwan's hot trading volumes inflating open-position margin requirements, 10 of the island's 14 dedicated futures brokers plan capital increases or bond issuance to shore up their capital base, after their adjusted-net-capital-to-margin (ANC) ratios slid. The FSC says all 14 remain compliant, and the futures exchange has begun a review of the framework.

items.title_zh: 壽險首季獲利 846 億元 前四月總保費衝 1 兆元
items.title_en: Life insurers post NT$84.6bn in Q1 profit; Jan–Apr premiums top NT$1tn
items.summary_zh: 台灣壽險業第一季合計獲利約 846 億元，僅三商美邦人壽出現虧損。前四月（1 至 4 月）總保費收入達 1 兆元，主要受惠資本市場熱絡與美元分紅保單買氣旺盛。此一數據顯示壽險業獲利動能回穩，保費規模重回兆元水準，美元利變、分紅型商品成為帶動買氣與業績的主力。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's life insurance industry earned about NT$84.6bn in the first quarter, with only Shin Kong Life (San Shang Mei Life) in the red. Total premium income for January–April reached NT$1tn, buoyed by buoyant capital markets and strong demand for US-dollar participating policies — a sign of recovering momentum across the life sector.

items.title_zh: 金管會提醒民眾防範信用卡遭詐騙盜刷
items.title_en: FSC warns the public to guard against credit-card fraud and unauthorised charges
items.summary_zh: 金管會發布公告，提醒民眾妥善保管信用卡資料、慎防釣魚簡訊與詐騙連結，並於發現可疑或未授權交易時立即通報、辦理止付。此提醒呼應近期詐騙活動升溫的情勢，意在督促發卡機構與持卡人共同強化交易監控與身分驗證機制，降低盜刷風險與民眾財損。
items.summary_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission issued a public advisory urging consumers to protect their credit-card data, beware of phishing and fraudulent links, and promptly report any suspicious or unauthorised transactions. The reminder comes amid rising scam activity and aims to push card issuers and consumers alike to tighten transaction-monitoring and verification.

items.title_zh: 中信金法說：台壽美元分紅保單買氣旺 新契約保費 468 億增 161%、養生村明年 Q1 開幕
items.title_en: CTBC earnings call: Taiwan Life's US-dollar participating policies drive a 161% jump in new-business premiums
items.summary_zh: 中信金控召開第一季法說會，旗下台灣人壽今年前 4 月新契約保費達 468 億元，較去年同期成長 161%，主因資本市場熱絡與美元分紅保單買氣暢旺。中信金並透露，台壽養生村最快 2027 年第一季開幕。對財富管理而言，美元分紅型保單熱銷反映高資產客戶對美元資產配置與穩健現金流的需求，養生村則延伸集團在高齡與退休傳承規劃的服務版圖。
items.summary_en: At CTBC Financial's Q1 call, subsidiary Taiwan Life reported NT$46.8bn of new-contract premiums for the first four months, up 161% year-on-year, driven by buoyant capital markets and brisk demand for US-dollar participating (dividend) policies. CTBC also said Taiwan Life's wellness-retirement village ("yangsheng village") is on track to open as early as Q1 2027 — extending the group's high-net-worth and retirement-planning offering.

items.title_zh: 聯博 00984D 主動式非投資等級債券 ETF 第二次配息維持 0.085 元
items.title_en: AllianceBernstein's actively managed global high-yield bond ETF (00984D) keeps its second payout at NT$0.085
items.summary_zh: 聯博投信首檔主動式非投資等級債券 ETF——聯博優選全球非投資等級債券主動式 ETF（00984D），第二次配息維持每單位 0.085 元，與首次持平，最遲約 6 月 1 日買進可參與配息。在 AI 題材推升全球股市頻創新高、又遭遇美伊戰事與通膨高於預期等變數下，市場高檔震盪風險升溫；對財富管理客戶而言，主動式高收益債 ETF 提供一個兼顧收益與波動管理的海外債配置選項。
items.summary_en: AllianceBernstein's first active non-investment-grade bond ETF, the AB Select Global High Yield Bond Active ETF (00984D), set its second distribution at NT$0.085 per unit, unchanged from the first. With AI-fuelled global equity highs colliding with US–Iran tensions and above-target inflation, the manager positions the fund as a yield-oriented option for investors seeking income amid elevated volatility; the latest buy-in date for the payout is around June 1.

items.title_zh: 金管會主委視察亞洲資產管理中心高雄資產管理專區
items.title_en: FSC chair inspects the Kaohsiung asset-management zone of the Asian Asset Management Centre
items.summary_zh: 金管會主委彭金隆視察高雄資產管理專區，該專區是台灣推動「亞洲資產管理中心」政策的旗艦項目之一。此次視察凸顯主管機關力推在南台灣發展資產管理、財富管理與高資產客群業務的政策方向。對私人銀行與財富管理業者而言，資產管理專區的法規鬆綁與租稅誘因，將牽動高資產客戶的境外資產配置與業務布局。
items.summary_en: FSC chairperson Peng Chin-lung inspected the Kaohsiung asset-management special zone, a flagship element of Taiwan's "Asian Asset Management Centre" initiative. The visit underscores regulators' push to develop offshore and high-net-worth asset-management business in southern Taiwan, a policy directly relevant to private-banking and wealth-management expansion.

items.title_zh: 台灣人壽攜手彰銀推「美利 33 美元終身壽險」 5 月新上市
items.title_en: Taiwan Life and Chang Hwa Bank launch the "Meili 33" US-dollar whole-life policy
items.summary_zh: 台灣人壽攜手彰化銀行銀保通路，於 5 月推出「美利 33 美元終身壽險」。該美元計價商品鎖定希望以美元建立長期保障與傳承規劃的客戶，反映財富管理通路對外幣保險商品的需求持續強勁。對財管與傳承業務而言，美元終身壽險可作為資產配置、稅務與身故傳承安排的工具之一，銀保通路仍是壽險新契約成長的重要動能。
items.summary_en: Taiwan Life, partnering with Chang Hwa Commercial Bank's bancassurance channel, launched the "Meili 33 US-dollar whole-life insurance" in May. The US-dollar-denominated product targets clients building long-term, dollar-based protection and legacy planning, reflecting continued strong demand for foreign-currency insurance solutions in the wealth-management channel.

items.title_zh: 賴政府執政二周年再釋利多 推「0 到 18 歲全程支持計畫」並祭育兒租稅減免
items.title_en: Lai administration's 2nd-anniversary package: "0-to-18 full-support plan" with childcare tax relief
items.summary_zh: 賴政府執政滿二周年，行政院長卓榮泰宣布推動「0 到 18 歲全程支持計畫」，將育嬰假升級為「育兒假」，適用年齡提高至 6 歲，所增加成本由政府負擔；另祭出租稅減免，據了解政院將考量加碼幼兒學前特別扣除額。對家庭與稅務規劃而言，幼兒學前特別扣除額若上調，將直接降低育兒家庭綜所稅負擔，相關修法與適用門檻值得後續追蹤。
items.summary_en: Marking two years in office, Premier Cho Jung-tai announced a "0-to-18 full-support plan" that upgrades parental leave into "childcare leave" usable up to a child's sixth birthday, with the added cost borne by the government. The package also includes tax breaks; reports say the cabinet is weighing an increase in the pre-school special deduction to ease the tax burden on families raising young children.

items.title_zh: 報稅季倒數：土銀繳稅加碼回饋、券商揭投資節稅攻略
items.title_en: Tax-filing season countdown: card-payment rebates and brokers' tax-saving tips
items.summary_zh: 五月綜合所得稅申報季進入倒數，金融機構紛紛推出優惠：臺灣土地銀行針對 JCB 信用卡持卡人，凡以行動支付 App 綁定繳稅，最高回饋 3,000 元；華南永昌證券則發布「投資節稅攻略」，整理扣除額與申報策略。此波活動顯示，報稅季已成為銀行與券商強化客戶互動、推廣節稅與理財服務的重要時點。
items.summary_en: With May individual income-tax filing season in its final stretch, financial institutions are rolling out incentives: Land Bank of Taiwan is offering rebates of up to NT$3,000 for JCB cardholders who pay taxes via mobile-payment apps, while Hua Nan Yung Chang Securities published an "investment tax-saving" guide covering deductions and filing strategies. The activity highlights tax season as a customer-engagement window for banks and brokerages.

items.title_zh: 台北股匯「雙殺」 熱錢匯出 新台幣重貶逾 1 角收 31.65 元
items.title_en: New Taiwan dollar slumps 10.5 cents to 31.65 as hot money flows out
items.summary_zh: 台北股匯市場 5 月 19 日上演「雙殺」，台股重挫、外資賣超擴大至 632 億元，熱錢匯出拖累新台幣一路走貶，終場收 31.65 元、探逾一個月低點，重貶 1.05 角，總成交量放大至 31.31 億美元，盤中一度測試 31.7 價位。新台幣走弱主要反映全球殖利率走升、美元轉強，以及外資撤離台股的賣壓，匯率後續走向牽動進出口與資金面。
items.summary_en: Taipei saw a "twin sell-off" in stocks and the currency on May 19. As the equity index plunged and foreign net selling expanded to NT$63.2bn, hot money flowed out and dragged the New Taiwan dollar to 31.65, a more-than-one-month low, down 10.5 cents, with turnover swelling to US$3.131bn. The currency briefly tested the 31.7 level intraday, pressured by rising global yields and a firmer US dollar.

items.title_zh: 賴政府執政二周年 軍公教研擬調薪、最低工資明年可望破 3 萬元
items.title_en: Lai administration weighs pay rises for military, civil servants and teachers; minimum wage seen topping NT$30,000
items.summary_zh: 賴政府執政滿二周年，行政院長卓榮泰表示，去年經濟成長率達 8.68%、產業有賺錢，就該多為勞工加薪，明年最低工資月薪可望突破 3 萬元；另為感謝軍公教長期付出與貢獻，將研擬軍公教調薪。調薪政策牽動國內消費動能、企業人事成本與政府財政負擔，同時也是執政滿兩年釋出的政策利多之一。
items.summary_en: Marking two years in office, Premier Cho Jung-tai said that with 2025 GDP growth at 8.68% and profitable industries, workers deserve raises — next year's minimum monthly wage could exceed NT$30,000. The government is also studying pay increases for military personnel, civil servants and teachers to recognise their long-term contributions.

items.title_zh: Fed 通膨預測成「股市惡夢」 美 5 月通膨恐破 4% 降息希望破滅
items.title_en: Cleveland Fed models flag US May inflation near 4%, dimming rate-cut hopes as Warsh is sworn in
items.summary_zh: 伊朗戰爭與荷姆茲海峽封鎖引爆能源危機，推升美國通膨急速升溫。克里夫蘭聯準銀行預估 5 月通膨率將達約 4.18%，第二季 CPI 年化增幅恐高達 6.89%。市場原期待的 Fed 降息恐落空，甚至可能重新升息。美國總統川普將於本週五為接替鮑爾的華許（Kevin Warsh）主持 Fed 主席宣誓典禮，新主席上任即面臨高通膨、能源價格飆升與關稅衝擊的多重夾擊。
items.summary_en: With the Iran conflict and Hormuz Strait disruptions driving an energy-price surge, the Cleveland Fed estimates US May inflation will reach about 4.18% and annualised Q2 CPI as high as 6.89%. Markets now expect the Fed to hold in June and even consider re-hiking, all but ending hopes for cuts. President Trump will swear in Kevin Warsh as Fed chair this Friday amid the inflation and geopolitical pressures.

items.title_zh: 美中關稅戰還沒完？貝森特：不急著延長休戰
items.title_en: US Treasury Secretary Bessent: no rush to extend the US–China tariff truce
items.summary_zh: 美國財政部長貝森特表示，川普政府目前「並不急於」延長與中國之間將於 11 月到期的關稅與關鍵礦物貿易休戰協議，認為雙方後續仍有足夠時間在今年稍晚的會談中進一步協商。此一表態為美中貿易前景與全球供應鏈布局再添不確定性，後續休戰能否延續、關鍵礦物供應安排，將是市場與出口導向產業關注焦點。
items.summary_en: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the Trump administration is "in no hurry" to extend the tariff-and-critical-minerals trade truce with China that expires in November, arguing there is still ample time to negotiate further at talks later this year. The comments inject fresh uncertainty into US–China trade and supply-chain expectations.

items.title_zh: 美股盤後：標普連三黑 30 年期美債殖利率創 19 年新高
items.title_en: US stocks fall for a third day as 30-year Treasury yield hits a 19-year high
items.summary_zh: 美股 5 月 19 日再度走弱，美債殖利率攀升與科技股回檔拖累大盤，標普 500 指數連續第三個交易日收黑。30 年期美國公債殖利率在債市再掀拋售下升抵 19 年新高，市場在輝達財報公布前轉趨觀望，AI 類股面臨獲利了結賣壓。長天期殖利率飆高反映財政赤字與通膨疑慮，正同步壓抑全球高估值股市。
items.summary_en: US equities weakened again on May 19 as climbing Treasury yields and a tech-stock pullback dragged the major indices; the S&P 500 logged a third straight decline. The 30-year Treasury yield rose to a 19-year high amid renewed bond selling, and markets turned cautious ahead of Nvidia's results, with AI names facing profit-taking pressure.

items.title_zh: 輝達財報前瞻：選擇權市場暗示 3,550 億美元市值波動 半導體股回檔
items.title_en: Nvidia earnings preview: options market braces for a US$355bn market-cap swing as chip stocks correct
items.summary_zh: 輝達將於台灣時間 5 月 21 日清晨（美股 20 日盤後）公布 2026 會計年度第一季財報，選擇權市場顯示，投資人正為財報後可能高達 3,550 億美元的單日市值波動預作準備。儘管股價已連三日走弱，華爾街分析師多維持樂觀，目標價普遍上看 300 美元以上；但半導體「動能股」明顯熄火，美光、Sandisk 五日跌幅近 14%，反映 AI 交易擁擠後的獲利了結壓力。
items.summary_en: Nvidia reports fiscal Q1 results after the US close on May 20. Options pricing implies investors are bracing for a post-earnings single-day market-cap swing of up to US$355bn. Despite three straight days of share-price weakness, Wall Street analysts have largely kept bullish targets — many at US$300 and above — even as semiconductor "momentum" names cool sharply, with Micron and SanDisk down nearly 14% over five sessions.

items.title_zh: Google I/O 登場：Gemini 3.5 Flash、AI 代理 Spark、世界模型 Omni 亮相
items.title_en: Google I/O unveils Gemini 3.5 Flash, general-purpose AI agent "Spark," and world model "Omni"
items.summary_zh: Google 在年度開發者大會 Google I/O 一口氣發布多項 AI 新品，包括新模型 Gemini 3.5 Flash、通用 AI 代理 Gemini Spark，以及可模擬真實世界的 Omni 模型。此波發表加劇與競爭對手的 AI 軍備競賽，也凸顯前沿模型與 AI 代理（Agent）能力進展之快。對產業而言，AI 代理與世界模型的商用化，將牽動雲端算力需求與軟體應用生態的下一波布局。
items.summary_en: At its annual Google I/O developer conference, Google unveiled a slate of new AI products, including the Gemini 3.5 Flash model, a general-purpose AI agent called Gemini Spark, and an "Omni" model capable of simulating the real world. The launches intensify the AI race against rivals and underline how fast frontier model and AI-agent capabilities are advancing.

items.title_zh: 美伊緊張升級：美參院倒戈限制川普戰權、美再擴大制裁伊朗
items.title_en: US–Iran tensions escalate: Senate moves to curb Trump's war powers as Washington widens sanctions
items.summary_zh: 美國參議院以 50:47 推進限制對伊朗軍事行動的決議案，共和黨參議員 Bill Cassidy 倒戈成關鍵一票，顯示共和黨內對川普伊朗政策出現分歧，雖然法案成法機率仍低。另一方面，美國宣布制裁逾 50 個與伊朗有關的實體與船舶，包括位於中國、香港與阿聯的相關企業；副總統范斯警告伊朗「只有兩條路可走」，美國隨時準備重啟軍事行動。美伊局勢牽動油價與全球避險情緒。
items.summary_en: The US Senate advanced a resolution to limit military action against Iran by 50–47, with Republican senator Bill Cassidy crossing the aisle as the pivotal vote — a sign of intra-party division over Trump's Iran policy, though the bill's path into law remains narrow. Separately, Washington sanctioned more than 50 Iran-linked entities and vessels, including firms in China, Hong Kong and the UAE; Vice President JD Vance warned Iran has "only two paths" and the US is ready to resume military action.

items.title_zh: 花旗示警中東風險 喊 Brent 原油上看 120 美元
items.title_en: Citi warns markets underprice Middle East risk, sees Brent crude up to US$120
items.summary_zh: 花旗預測 Brent 原油短期可能升至每桶 120 美元，並警告市場低估了中東供應中斷的風險。儘管美伊談判傳出進展壓抑油價漲勢，但荷姆茲海峽變數、庫存下降與地緣政治風險，仍可能推動能源市場進一步震盪。油價走高將透過運輸與原物料成本傳導至全球通膨，與 Fed 利率路徑、台廠成本壓力環環相扣。
items.summary_en: Citi forecast that Brent crude could climb to US$120 a barrel in the near term, warning the market is underestimating the risk of Middle East supply disruptions. Although signs of progress in US–Iran talks have capped price gains, uncertainty over the Strait of Hormuz, falling inventories and geopolitical risk could still push the energy market into further turbulence.
